map.RR=暴露组发病率/非暴露组发病率。: RR = incidence in the exposed group / incidence in the unexposed group.

map.暴露组 40/60 发病、非暴露组 30/90：RR=(40/60)/(30/9: 40/60 cases in the exposed group and 30/90 in the unexposed group give RR=(40/60)/(30/90)=0.667/0.333=2.0, so exposure carries twice the risk of the control group.
map.RR=0.5：暴露组发病率仅对照一半（保护效应）。: RR=0.5 means incidence in the exposed group is half that of the controls (a protective effect).

map.相对风险（本页代码口径，四格表计数输入）：暴露组发生率 e1=a÷(a+b)；非: Relative risk (as coded on this page; four-cell counts as input): incidence in the exposed group e1=a÷(a+b); incidence in the unexposed group e0=c÷(c+d); RR=e1÷e0. Validation: the four fields a, b, c, d are mandatory via input guards and must be valid numbers, otherwise a prompt is shown and the calculation stops. Criteria: no fixed grading; RR>1 means the exposed group has a higher outcome risk, <1 lower, and =1 no association; the main result keeps 4 decimals.
